name: NeuralSync Dance Collective — Open Floor Nights
description: One of GLMZ's oldest recurring social institutions, NeuralSync Open Floor Nights operate in licensed venues across Tier 2 and 3 districts, facilitating voluntary BCI rhythm-synchronization between dancers on a shared floor — participants opt into a low-intensity neural link that shares proprioceptive rhythm data, creating genuine physical entrainment between strangers without sharing memory or identity. The experience is described by regulars as 'being briefly the same body moving' and has accrued decades of subculture around it, including specific movement vocabularies, floor etiquette, and a lineage of celebrated human DJs who design sets specifically for synchronization architecture.
story_hooks: A regular at a NeuralSync night realizes she has been unconsciously memorizing the movement patterns of a specific other dancer — and that this dancer appears in no city registry, no feed, no record

Someone is using the low-intensity sync network at a specific venue as a covert data transmission channel, embedding encoded information in rhythm patterns that only a specific recipient's BCI will recognize

A NeuralSync DJ receives an anonymous commission to design a set with very specific synchronization parameters — parameters that, she realizes, would create a predictable physiological state in every person on the floor simultaneously
